verdict.rationale: There is no native workflow builder with loops, conditionals, or parameters. The evidence instead shows prompt-driven runs (`client.runs.create` with a goal) that can be chained in multi-run sessions, continued across checkpoints like 2FA, and driven from your own Python code. Repeatable control flow is therefore only achievable by scripting it yourself around the SDK. Missing for 10: first-class workflow definitions, loop/conditional primitives, parameterized/templated tasks, saved reusable workflows, and any hands-on corroboration.
